# @mission-platform/three

Framework-neutral Three.js integration for Mission Platform.

## Components

### ForgeThreeCanvas
`ForgeThreeCanvas(properties: Readonly<ForgeThreeCanvasProperties>): MpElement`
Renders a `<canvas>` and manages a Three.js context.
Props:
- `onReady?: (ctx: ThreeContext) => void | (() => void)`

## Hooks

### useThree
`useThree(canvasRef: MpRef<HTMLCanvasElement | null>, onReady?: (ctx: ThreeContext) => void | (() => void)): void`
Manages a Three.js context bound to a canvas ref.

## Types

### ThreeContext
```typescript
interface ThreeContext {
  renderer: THREE.WebGLRenderer;
  scene: THREE.Scene;
  camera: THREE.PerspectiveCamera;
}
```

## Implementation Details
- SSR-safe.
- Automatic cleanup of renderer and animation frames.
